verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents official install paths for Docker and Kubernetes (kubectl, kustomize, helm), plus pip and bare metal, and has a quick-start command that pulls and starts the image. That covers the container and Helm parts of the story, but the evidence does not show Docker Compose specifically, a small-VPS guide, Raspberry Pi support, or a separate maintained guide for each target. missing for 10: Docker Compose guide, small VPS guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM deployment guide, evidence of dedicated maintained per-target guides, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, official deployment paths cover my target — Docker Compose, Kubernetes/Helm, a small VPS, or a Raspberry Pi — each with its own maintained guide
